content: The best time to visit Nadi (NAN), Fiji is between July and September. This period is during the dry season when the beaches are sunny and there's less rainfall. The temperature is also more moderate and comfortable for outdoor activities, making it a perfect time for sightseeing, swimming, and water sports. During these months, you can also enjoy various local events and festivals. However, please note that this is also the peak tourist season, so the prices for flights and accommodations may be higher.
